description: Exploration of the interfaces between combinatorics and Computer Science. Algorithms and data structures that are used to manipulate, generate, and randomly select combinatorial objects, including sets, permutations, combinations, trees, graphs. Methods for analyzing combinatorial algorithms such as recurrence relations, asymptotics, and amortized complexity.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of the following
    • Complete 1 of the following
      • Earn a minimum grade of B+ in each of the following:
        • CSC226 - Algorithms and Data Structures II (1.5)
      • Complete all of the following
        • Earn a minimum grade of B+ in each of the following:
          • CSC225 - Algorithms and Data Structures I (1.5)
        • Earn a minimum grade of B in each of the following:
          • MATH222 - Discrete and Combinatorial Mathematics (1.5)
    • minimum third-year standing.
supplementalNotes:
• Credit will be granted for only one of CSC 428A, CSC 528.
  • May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
title: Combinatorial Algorithms
